review: 2:3 מַפְגִּיעַ — 'intercedes'; the hiph'il of פגע in this sense is biblical (Isa 53:12), and it is the fixed glossary word for الشفاعة.
2:1 רָחַץ ... אֶת־עָוֺן — the definite object marker on an indefinite noun is unusual; it is there to land the line on 8 syllables.
5:2 לְכַבּוֹת — deliberate echo of Song 8:7, 'מַיִם רַבִּים לֹא יוּכְלוּ לְכַבּוֹת אֶת־הָאַהֲבָה'.
6:3 תַּגֵּדְנָה — feminine plural, agreeing with שְׂפָתַיִם (a dual form that takes feminine plural agreement).
4:1 הִנְנִי־חַי — the Arabic 'هٰأَنٰذَا' is the Johannine 'הִנְנִי'; joined with חַי it keeps the line to 8.
